scenes: Two pizzas. Worth over seven hundred million dollars today.
May eighteenth, twenty ten. A man in Florida posts online:
Ten thousand bitcoin, for two pizzas.
Four days later, a nineteen-year-old student says yes.
He orders two Papa John's pizzas to the man's door.
Those ten thousand bitcoin were worth about forty-one dollars.
Today, they're worth over seven hundred million.
And the student who got them?
He spent them all. On travel.
He says he's proud he played a part.
